name: Pan African Resources PLC
source: Pan African Resources PLC summarised audited consolidated results for the year ended 30 June 2026, summarised consolidated statement of financial position page 30, printed in US$ thousands and stored here as absolute USD, the same basis as the existing columns. Total non-current assets 1,279,570; total current assets 328,505; total assets 1,608,075; total non-current liabilities 349,328; total current liabilities 222,750; total equity 1,035,997; cash and cash equivalents 108,312. Total liabilities 572,078 is the printed non-current and current liabilities added, which is the figure that makes total assets equal total liabilities plus total equity. Every FY2025 comparative printed alongside agrees with the values already stored.
